verdict.rationale: Token2's own fido2-manage tool manages resident keys (passkeys) on FIDO2.1 devices, including listing them with user handles, deleting them, and editing metadata. Its SSH support lists and rehydrates resident keys. Together these strongly indicate discoverable-credential storage, though the tool is manufacturer-agnostic rather than a direct product spec for Token2 keys. Missing for 10: explicit Token2 key spec stating discoverable-credential support and slot capacity, documentation of usernameless WebAuthn sign-in flows, independent hands-on corroboration.
